description: OpenCode detection rules, from its own `OC | <session>` title.

rules.why: OpenCode's own title (`OC | <session>`, after an optional wrapper label or status glyph) carries a braille spinner frame while a turn runs, as the dot's title classifier reads it.
OpenCode's own title (`OC | <session>`) without a spinner frame is its rest title, which it owns, so a hookless pane can still be read at rest.
